issue.description:
Parent: the R041 umbrella (agent-friction:umbrella). Implements R041 decision 4 as specified by the spec child. Blocked by the json-documents child so every new --json output uses the final shapes.

Problem: agents reach for commands that do not exist. Counts: `list | grep` 4,319, `bead search` 844, `bead ready` 261, `dep list|tree` 256, bare `bead <ID>` 90, `list --all` dozens, plus GROUP BY counts run with raw sqlite3. Each miss costs a parser error, a --help read and a retry.

Scope:
- `bead ready` (= `list --ready`), `bead search TEXT` (= `list --all --search TEXT`).
- `list --all`, `list --search TEXT`, `list --count`.
- `dep list ID` showing blockers and dependents with kind and blocker status, with --json.
- `bead ID` as `show ID` when the token has the workspace's issue-ID shape; a subcommand name always wins.

Acceptance:
- `bead ready --json` equals `bead list --ready --json` byte for byte; `bead search` equals its list form.
- `list --search` matches title, description and notes case-insensitively and combines with --status, --assignee and --ready.
- `list --count` prints an integer (JSON: an object with `count`) and respects every filter.
- `dep list ID --json` lists both directions with kind and blocker status; a nonexistent ID exits 3.
- `bead <ID>` equals `bead show <ID>`; a token that is neither a subcommand nor ID-shaped is still a usage error.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.notes: Recovered attempt 1's uncommitted implementation from the shared tree and verified it against the acceptance criteria, then completed the pieces the new commands require: read-only classifications in cli_checkpoint_guard (dep list unguarded, ready/search allowlisted) and cli_secret_scan (dep list returns no canonical request; ready/search read-only), plus NonMutating classifications for ready/search/dep list in the event-contract suite (every_leaf_command_is_classified otherwise fails new leaf commands). Committed a6c0cbbc (8 files: cli.rs, main.rs, service/issues.rs, service/mod.rs, cli_checkpoint_guard.rs, cli_secret_scan.rs, tests/cli_read_shortcuts.rs, tests/mutating_command_event_contract.rs), pushed, rev-list origin/main..HEAD empty. Foreign co-workers' WIP (reproducible-build, secret-scan, checkpoint-resilience files) left untouched. Verification on the committed bytes (git-archive extraction proven byte-identical to the tested tree): cargo fmt --check exit 0; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exit 0; cargo test exit 0 (full suite); cargo test --test cli_read_shortcuts exit 0 (13/13: byte-for-byte ready/list-ready and search/list parity, search across title/description/notes case-insensitive, count plain+JSON with filters, --all ignores --limit, dep list both directions with kind+status, exit 3 on unknown ID, bare ID equals show, unknown non-ID token stays a usage error, subcommand wins); cargo test --test mutating_command_event_contract exit 0 (4/4). scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast running on the committed extraction to finish as final evidence.
issue.title: Add read shortcuts: ready, search, list --all/--search/--count, dep list, bare ID

issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies post-0.1 item R025: add a third dependency kind `verifies` so authors can declare a check relationship, and diagnose inverted verification gates structurally (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) instead of via title heuristics, which the ADR explicitly forbids. Measured basis: 21 inverted edges in one live workspace and 24 plus 7 cycles in another (2026-08-12), a persistent 4-6% authoring error rate that bead-rs currently accepts silently. Work: extend the dependency schema, `bead manifest`, import/export round trips, event and checkpoint serialization for the new kind; add the diagnosis as an advisory report (doctor / list surface) that never rejects the edge at insert time and never infers the relationship from titles; keep the section 3.4 two-kind cycle check unchanged; document in help, `bead schema explain`, and capabilities; add conformance and concurrency tests covering declared-verifies pairs, ordinary blocks pairs, and the advisory-only contract.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the declared `verifies` dependency kind and structural inversion diagnosis (ADR-001 / R025)
